faqs.q: How can I manage my toll account or pass?
faqs.a: You can manage your toll account by ordering an eMU Casual Pass, applying for an ERider pass, or setting up an E-Toll account.

faqs.q: What options do I have for claiming toll rebates?
faqs.a: You can claim rebates for frequent toll use, the M5 South-West Cashback Scheme, or for large towed recreational vehicles.

faqs.q: How do I pay a toll or a toll notice?
faqs.a: You can pay a toll or toll notice directly, or pay a specific Toll Notice for the Sydney Harbour Bridge or Tunnel.

faqs.q: What should I do if I need to dispute a toll notice?
faqs.a: You can dispute a toll notice or submit a statutory declaration if necessary.
